turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
t’s frustrating when tracking seems stuck. If your package has already shipped and the tracking is not updating, the best next step is to check with FedEx directly for the most current transit details, since delays in transit are handled by the carrier. We are not able to offer refunds or credits for carrier delays. If you still have not received the order after it is marked delivered, please wait 2 business days and also check with neighbors or your building front desk just in case 🙂
